notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Small patch to fix the first issues that have been reported, as well as adding a bit of translation to the game!
Do tell if there is a hiccup with those, the system is fresh so there could be bugs.

[b]Changelog 1.0.2:[/b]

Added translations: 
French
Simplified Chinese (by Sunny Daisy)

Added visual support for AZERTY keyboards.
Fixed a bug where cannonballs would go through obstacles.
Fixed a bug where one couldn't take the ship stairs.
Fixed a bug making the credits' Exit button not work.
Fixed a few typos.

Known bugs:
Sometimes the enemy ship stops taking damage, seems to be only visual feedback.
Animation cancelling a certain action (thanks Tap, you fighting game junkie).

notes.title: Release date delay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, as you know the game was meant to be released on September 27th, however it will have to be delayed for a few days. The reason for that is some administrative issues that I didn't expect having to tackle at the last minutes, it's my fault on that one.
Expect to see the release happen over the course of the next week, as soon as Monday on the 30th, or a few days later. I don't know exactly when it will be available. Fret not, the game is ready and kicking, and this is just some technical mishap.

Sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you very much for your patience! As always you can come follow the game's development on the Discord server and ask me questions in details there.

notes.title: Alpha Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am glad to share with all of you the release of the alpha state for Sail of Dreams!
This is a short demo that includes the main mechanics of the naval battle, as well as the core visuals.
If you run into any trouble and/or want to give feedback, i recommend you join the official Discord server to share your impressions: discord.gg/YSccajsysV

I hope you all enjoy this playtest!
